subject: Pen test vendor selection: SOW clarifications & schedule
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jake Thompson <jake.thompson@redteamlabs.com>, Nora Li <nora.li@fortifysec.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test vendor selection: SOW clarifications & schedule

Hi Jake / Nora —

Thanks again for the proposals. Leadership has narrowed this down to RedTeam Labs (scoped red-team + application testing) and FortifySec (appsec + CI/CD review). Before we route either SOW to procurement/legal, a couple quick clarifications so we can compare apples-to-apples:

- Scope endpoints: please confirm whether mobile APIs are in-scope or require a separate add-on. We've got one mobile client with feature flags that touch auth flows.
- Evidence delivery: we need machine-readable findings (CSV/JSON) and a drilldown for reproducing in our test env. Can you confirm format and timeline after testing?
- Scheduling window: ideal test window is Oct 6–17 (two-week window with 3 business days of rundown + debrief). Can you commit to that or propose alternatives?
- Retest / remediation verification: include firm pricing for one follow-up retest within 30 days.

Attached Im including the internal risk register and the RFP comparison matrix for your reference. Please reply with a one-paragraph confirmation and updated SOW attachments if any changes.

Goal: finalize vendor + SOW by EOD Thu 9/4 so procurement can issue PO and we can lock an October window.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Risk_Register.xlsx

From: Jake Thompson <jake.thompson@redteamlabs.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: contracts@redteamlabs.com
Date: Mon, 1 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test vendor selection: SOW clarifications & schedule

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the notes and the risk register. Quick answers inline: 

- Mobile APIs: covered in our standard red-team package (no add-on). We'll include Android/iOS API endpoints for auth, payment telemetry, and feature-flag flows as long as you provide test credentials and access to the staging API gateway.
- Evidence delivery: we provide a CSV export and a human-readable report. For integrations, we can also generate JSON findings that map to the OWASP ASVS sections you use. We'll deliver the JSON + CSV within 72 hours of the final debrief.
- Scheduling: Oct 6–17 works for our red-team squad. We will block those dates once the PO is issued.
- Retest: one follow-up retest within 30 days is $2,400 flat (4 hours of verification + report).

I've attached RTLabs_SOW_v3.pdf with minor updates to the evidence format section and added the retest line item. If you want us to include a narrow CI/CD pipeline review as part of the engagement, that's an extra day and $1,200.

If that all looks good we can route to contracts and sign — DocuSign link will be ready once you confirm the final line items.

Cheers,
Jake Thompson
Director, RedTeam Labs

Attachment: RTLabs_SOW_v3.pdf

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Sep 2025 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pen test vendor selection: SOW clarifications & schedule

Folks —

Forwarding Jake's confirmation and SOW draft from RedTeam. Key points for our internal decision: 

- RedTeam confirms mobile APIs are in-scope (good).
- Deliverables include JSON export we can ingest into our tracker (per Dev's ask).
- Pricing: retest $2,400; optional CI/CD review +$1,200.
- They can commit to Oct 6–17.

Trade-off vs FortifySec: Fortify quoted lower base fee but does not include a follow-up retest without additional spend, and their evidence export is manual CSV only. Evelyn/Marissa — any red flags from compliance? Laura — any procurement/legal concerns on the SOW terms (liability, disclosure windows, data-handling)? Dev — does the evidence format and 72-hour delivery align with engineering triage capacity?

Proposed next step: if no major objections, Id like to approve RedTeam SOW (include retest) and ask contracts to prepare PO + DocuSign by EOD Thu 9/4 to lock dates.

Thanks,
Dylan

On Sep 1, 2025, at 11:03 AM, Jake Thompson <jake.thompson@redteamlabs.com> wrote:
> (quoted) see attached SOW v3 and answers to your clarifications

Attachments included above: RTLabs_SOW_v3.pdf

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pen test vendor selection: SOW clarifications & schedule

Thanks — I reviewed RTLabs_SOW_v3 and the changes look reasonable. A couple of notes before final sign: 

1) Data handling: they state they will use staging creds and will not exfiltrate production data. Add clause to SOW requiring confirmation of staging-only access and a 48-hour window to pause testing if accidental production traffic is observed.
2) Remediation verification: retest fee is acceptable, but require that the retest scope is limited to validated fixes rather than a full re-test (add wording to SOW).
3) Evidence retention: request a 6-month retention period for their raw findings export; we will delete after that unless required by audit.

Dev — confirm the JSON field mapping they propose (they sent a sample schema in the Drive link) is compatible with our ingestion; if any changes needed, flag by EOD Thu 9/4. Laura — if legal is OK with the two SOW additions above, we can proceed to DocuSign and PO.

If all green, I'll mark vendor selection approved and loop procurement.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: FortifySec_questionnaire_responses.xlsx (for comparison)
